responsibility: Declares the selective scheduler’s dumping/debugging API and the flag enums that control how CFGs, insns, vinsns, expressions, and related scheduler data structures are rendered. It is the shared interface between selective scheduling logic and its textual or .dot visualization support, exposing both normal dump helpers and DEBUG_FUNCTION entry points.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the dump/debug flags and declares the selective scheduler visualization and logging interfaces. The same-stem source gcc/sel-sched-dump.cc contains the actual formatting, temporary dump redirection, CFG/.dot generation, and DEBUG_FUNCTION implementations.
